name: App Store
author: Enplace
summary: Follow an app on the App Store: its icon, live version, review, rating, reviews and downloads.
description: Goes on an app product. Link the app to its App Store listing to get its icon, the live version and its rating, and add App Store Connect keys to follow each version through review and read its reviews. With your vendor number too, it shows downloads, purchases and where they come from. With Release cycle on, the cycle numbers releases from what's live and follows each one through review. For Android, add Google Play to the same product.

settings.name: App Store app
settings.help: Its bundle ID like com.example.app, its App Store link or its App Store ID. Or search for it above.

settings.name: On the project's overview
settings.help: How the app's downloads, rating and reviews show on the overview. The App page always has all of it.

settings.name: Issuer ID
settings.help: App Store Connect → Users and Access → Integrations → App Store Connect API.

settings.name: Key ID
settings.help: The ID of the key you generated there.

settings.name: Private key (.p8)
settings.help: Paste the whole .p8 file, including the BEGIN and END lines.

settings.name: Vendor number
settings.help: For downloads and purchases. App Store Connect → Payments and Financial Reports, the number beside your name at the top. The key above also needs the Sales, Finance or Admin role.

tools.name: get_app
tools.description: A product's App Store app: its bundle ID, the version live on the App Store, rating, each version's state in App Store Connect when keys are set, and with a vendor number its downloads, purchases and latest reviews.
